test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Indolent
solution: The correct answer is '**Energetic**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**indolent**' is '**energetic**'. • **Indolent**: not wanting to work; lazy. (काम न करनेवाला; आलसी; निष्क्रिय) • *Example: **indolent** students/managers...* • **Energetic**: full of or needing energy and enthusiasm. (शक्ति व उमंग संपन्‍न, ऊर्जायुक्त, कर्मठ) • *Example: Jogging is a very **energetic** form of exercise.* **Correct Answer:__*** **energetic.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **listless**: tired and without energy. (थका और सुस्‍त, निरुत्‍साही) • **torpid**: not active; moving or thinking slowly because you are feeling tired or lazy; without any energy or enthusiasm. (निष्क्रिय; आलस्य या थकान के कारण धीरे-धीरे चलने या सोचनेवाला, सुस्त, सुप्त; निरुत्साही या मंद) • **languid**: weak or faint from illness or fatigue. (बीमारी या थकान से कमजोर या बेहोश) f1:Tabf, The correct answer is '**Cardiologist**'.
